title: Grateful Dead Live at Zoo Amphitheater on 1982-08-01

ai_review.summary: Solid soundboard recording of Jerry’s 40th‑birthday show – heat‑strained first set, but a smoking Playin > Iko jam and strong second half.
ai_review.review: The tape captures a decent soundboard mix that is generally clear though a few reviewers note low levels or minor drop‑outs. The concert was hampered by extreme heat, making the early part feel sluggish, but the band found its groove in the second set with a standout Playin > Iko sequence, Lost Sailor > Saint, and a tight China Cat Sunflower > Rider stretch.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating (~3.5) reflects generally positive remarks about the second set and recording clarity, offset by several low‑star comments on heat‑induced poor vibe and weak first set.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mostly clear and balanced SBD; a few notes of low overall levels, occasional drop‑outs in the first set, but far better than audience tapes.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set flows seamlessly with continuous segues (Playin > Iko, then into Lost Sailor > Saint, etc.), giving the night its memorable momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Distressed by heat early on; later delivers celebratory birthday solos and a fiery Playin > Iko jam.
band_member_comments.Bob: Makes a “lettin’ all the animals out” zoo joke, referencing the hot‑caged animal vibe.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drumming praised as solid and energetic, especially in the second set.
